title: Update Account Fingerprint
description: Change any fingerprint setting on its own and keep every other one. Changing os, os_version or a browser version regenerates the user agents the way Work does. Never pass a cookie value: set replaceCookie and the person enters it in a trusted sheet.

inputSchema.description: Change any fingerprint setting on its own and keep every other one. Changing os, os_version or a browser version regenerates the user agents the way Work does. Never pass a cookie value: set replaceCookie and the person enters it in a trusted sheet.

accountId.description: Opaque account reference returned by accounts.list or accounts.get.

patch.description: Fingerprint settings to change; omitted fields retain their current value. Cookie values and device credentials are never accepted.

language.description: Browser language code from accounts.fingerprint.options.get; empty follows the IP address.

time_zone.description: ip follows the IP address, local uses the local time zone, or a time zone from accounts.fingerprint.options.get.

dnt.description: Do Not Track: 1 is on, 0 or empty is off.

battery.description: Battery fingerprint setting; empty retains the disabled state.

screen_resolution_input.description: Predefined screen size for screen mode 1: UA follows the user agent, or a size from accounts.fingerprint.options.get for the account system.

os.description: Operating system. Changing it regenerates the user agents and the screen resolution.

os_version.description: Operating system version from accounts.fingerprint.options.get for that system, for example 11 for Windows.

userAgentVersion132.description: Browser version pool of the 132 kernel; All uses the kernel version.

userAgentVersion120.description: Browser version pool of the 120 kernel; All uses the kernel version.

randomize_user_agent.description: Generate a new user agent for one kernel or for both. Applied once; not stored.

port_protect.description: Port protection: 0 is off; 1-<ports> is on with a comma-separated port list, for example 1-80,81.

webrtc.description: WebRTC: 1 replaces with the proxy IP and needs a network device on the account (see accounts.network.set), 0 blocks, empty uses the real value.

geolocationIsIp.description: Whether geolocation follows the IP address. False uses the latitude, longitude and accuracy, unless geolocation is blocked.

geolocationLatitude.description: Latitude from 0 to 90, as Work accepts it.

geolocationLongitude.description: Longitude from 0 to 180, as Work accepts it.

webgl_metadata.description: WebGL vendor and renderer together as <manufacturer>;<renderer> from the Work list; empty uses the real value. Do not combine with webManufacturer or webGLRendering.

webManufacturer.description: WebGL manufacturer from accounts.fingerprint.options.get; empty uses the real value. A new manufacturer picks one of its renderers unless webGLRendering is also set.

webGLRendering.description: WebGL renderer of the current or given manufacturer, from accounts.fingerprint.options.get.

webgpu.description: WebGPU: match-webgl follows the WebGL setting, disabled turns it off, real uses the real value.

screenDisplay.description: Screen mode: 1 predefined, 2 custom size, 3 privacy (a random listed size).

screen_auto_left.description: Custom screen width from 1 to 9999, for screen mode 2.

screen_auto_right.description: Custom screen height from 1 to 9999, for screen mode 2.

font_mode.description: Fonts: privacy generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

battery_mode.description: Battery: privacy generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

bluetooth_mode.description: Bluetooth: privacy generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

speech_voices_mode.description: Speech voices: privacy generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

audio_context_mode.description: Audio context: noise generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

client_rects_mode.description: Client rectangles: noise generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

media_device_mode.description: Media devices: noise generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

canvas_mode.description: Canvas: noise generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

webgl_image_mode.description: WebGL image: noise generates a value the way Work does and keeps one already set; real uses the real value. Applied once, not stored.

replaceCookie.description: Ask the person to enter this account's fingerprint cookie in a trusted sheet. The value never passes through this tool.

clearCookie.description: Remove the cookie saved in this account's fingerprint.

outputSchema.description: Account operation result. status/stage are for internal reconciliation, not user-facing open-success/failure badges. Report the separate autofill receipt; a page being open never proves fill or sign-in.

autofill.description: Separate sign-in receipt: the DSphere account manager signs in on the opened page. Query accounts.operations.get with operationId while running; unknown must not be replayed. succeeded: the sign-in form was sent and the page no longer asks to sign in. skipped with already-signed-in, no-sign-in-form or site-unreachable (the tab shows the browser's error page): nothing was typed.

reason.description: Safe reason code; never credentials or page field values.

operationId.description: Local operation reference; not a Pangu request receipt.

stage.description: Completed or current account business stage.

pageContextId.description: Actual opened/focused page reference when known.

warnings.description: Bounded warnings, including synchronization and unknown outcomes.

data.description: Only the selected account operation's public product fields.

guidance:
Send only the setting to change; every other one is kept. Read accepted values from accounts.fingerprint.options.get. For an on/off metric use its _mode field (for example canvas_mode: noise), which generates the value the way Work does.

Linked settings follow Work: a new os redraws the user agents and the screen size, a new webManufacturer picks a renderer, and WebGPU follows WebGL. WebRTC replace needs a network device on the account.

Never ask the person to type a cookie into the conversation and never pass one: set replaceCookie and DSphere asks in its own SidePanel sheet, or set clearCookie to remove it. fingerprint.get reports only hasCookie.
